description: Sjökortsdata skala 1:10 000 (tiff) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Raster data mirrored from the Swedish Maritime Administration's chart database for the scale area 1:15 000. Chart data is symbolized by chart appearance (Short1, IHO S-4). Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Chart data scale 1:10 000 (tiff)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
